title: Sun Pharma to Raise Rs 10,000 Crore Through Bond Issue to Refinance Organon Acquisition Loan

contentHtml:
Mumbai: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries plans to raise 100 billion rupees (USD1.05 billion), including a greenshoe option of 30 billion rupees, through two tranches of five-year and one-day bonds, three merchant bankers said on Monday.

The issuer plans to raise up to 30 billion rupees through the first tranche, which will have a put option at end of 17 months, and at least 50 billion rupees with a greenshoe of 20 billion rupees through a bullet structure maturity.

It will pay an annual coupon of 8.05% and 8.20% on these papers, and has invited bids from bankers and investors on Thursday.

The company did not reply to a Reuters email seeking comment.

Late last month, Reuters had reported that Sun Pharma, is likely to raise rupee debt to partly refinance a dollar bridge loan availed for its acquisition of New York-listed healthcare company Organon.

Bridge loans are short-term loans taken before acquisitions to provide financing for the deal, and can be replaced with more permanent funding via bonds or loans.

Source : Reuters
